Maid Cafe Simulator

Overview

Maid Cafe Simulator - Official Trailer

Run a maid café with five charming kemonomimi maids! Make drinks, serve customers, and tackle troublemakers in this first-person management sim. Get to know the girls behind the aprons as you turn a rundown café into a thriving business and aim for three Maidchelin stars.

Read the full disclosureQuoted from the Steam store page

• Translation: The in-game text and store page text in languages other than Korean were translated using AI tools, so some translations may read unnaturally or contain inaccuracies. We are running a community translation project on our Discord server and do our best to reflect players' suggestions in future updates. If you'd like to help, we'd truly appreciate it!

• Art: Some food and cooking-related props were initially generated with AI-assisted tools and then manually refined by our artists to match the game's visual style and quality standards.

• Audio: Some short customer vocal sounds heard during café service (brief reactions and exclamations) were created using AI voice generation tools. All spoken dialogue in the game was recorded by real voice performers.
